notes.en: Cross-compiled zai CLI packages built from one pinned source revision.
notes.zh-CN: 由同一份固定源代码修订版交叉编译出的 zai CLI 安装包。

notes.en: Release archives are published publicly while the application source stays private.
notes.zh-CN: 应用源代码保持私有，仅公开发布安装包。

notes.en: Every archive is unsigned; verify the SHA-256 shown on the download page.
notes.zh-CN: 所有压缩包均未签名；请核对下载页显示的 SHA-256 校验值。

installNotes.en: Unsigned build. Install with the one-line installer, which verifies this archive's SHA-256, installs the zai family under your home directory, and updates the Windows user PATH or common macOS/Linux shell profiles. Open a new terminal and run zai. Python 3.10 or newer, Node.js/npm, and GitHub Copilot CLI are required.
installNotes.zh-CN: 未签名的构建。请使用一行安装命令；它会校验该压缩包的 SHA-256，把 zai 应用系列安装到主目录下，并更新 Windows 用户 PATH 或常见的 macOS/Linux shell 配置文件。打开新终端后运行 zai。需要 Python 3.10 及以上、Node.js/npm 以及 GitHub Copilot CLI。
